text: Hello, and welcome to live coverage of this Premier League fixture at Villa Park, as Aston Villa host Luton Town.
Villa’s resurgence under Unai Emery has continued at pace in 2023-24, with the hosts currently sat fifth on a five-game unbeaten run.
That’s included four wins too, including a 6-1 hammering of Brighton, and they come into this game having thumped West Ham 4-1 last time out.
It’s been a different story for Premier League newcomers Luton though, with the Hatters third-bottom on just five points after nine games.

A first win of the season at Everton on matchday seven is yet to be replicated, though after consecutive home losses to Burnley and Tottenham, Rob Edwards’ side did produce a glorious late comeback to draw 2-2 with Nottingham Forest in their last game.
Villa have won 4-1 in their last two games, also beating AZ Alkmaar on the continent, and Emery makes four changes from the latter victory ahead of this one.
Ezri Konsa and Pau Torres will occupy the heart of the defence, while Nicolo Zaniolo and Moussa Diaby will look to cause plenty of problems in the final third.
Douglas Luiz netted either side of half-time against the Hammers, and keeps his place, as does fellow scorer Ollie Watkins up front.
The Hatters make three changes themselves, as Issa Kabore and Ross Barkley come into the wide and central positions of a midfield formation which will shift between 5-3-2 and 3-5-2.
Gabriel Osho is also picked to start in defence for the first time this season.
Elijah Adebayo, who’s 92nd-minute equaliser salvaged a point against Forest, will look to make a similar impact from the bench.
The teams head out onto the pitch amidst an electric Villa Park atmosphere, and we'll be ready for kick-off in just a matter of moments!
Former Villa midfielder Barkley kicks off for Luton, and we're underway in the West Midlands!
Diaby sparks an early Villa chance after latching onto Kamara's ball into the box.
Digne and Zaniolo arrive in support to his left, and a deflected shot from the latter is punched away from danger by Kaminski!
Morris runs in behind the defence to latch onto Barkley's throughball, but he's a mile offside when he does so.
He's allowed to carry on though and has a tame shot in the box blocked, and only after that passage of play is the flag raised by the linesman!

WIDE!!! A golden chance for Villa to hit the front! Diaby's square ball into the box is flicked up by Watkins for Zaniolo, whose side-footed volley flashes inches wide of the far post with Kaminski nowhere near it!
The last encounter between these two sides - a League Cup match in August 2016 - saw Luton beat the Villans 3-1 at Kenilworth Road.
Zaniolo looks to step inside Brown and Kabore but is clipped late by the latter, gifting Villa a free-kick in a promising position to cross from.
WIDE!!! Diaby and Digne combine down the left, and the Villa full-back cuts the ball back towards the six-yard box.
Zaniolo's there at the near post, but his first-time effort takes a deflection off Mengi and goes behind for a corner!
Luiz's corner is flicked away by Ogbene at the far post, but Zaniolo recovers possession for Villa.
He whips a cross in from the right, but Kaminski dives low to claim the ball before Torres can get there.
SAVED!!! Konsa's long ball from deep finds Cash surging into the final third.
He crosses for Watkins in the area, but his early shot is parried by Kaminski and the Luton goalkeeper follows up with another excellent stop to keep the Villa striker at bay!
Watkins is the target as Digne hangs up a cross into the box, but Kaminski's there again to make the catch and deny the striker another chance at goal.
A tangle between the number 12's sees Kabore penalised again, who drags down Digne after being beaten on the inside by the Aston Villa left-back.

GOOOOOAAAALLL!!!! A well-taken opener from the Villa captain!!! The free-kick is played across the edge of the box by Luiz to McGinn, who is given all the time in the world to step away from Ogbene and into the area before slotting the ball into the far corner! You can't say it hasn't been coming, as the Villans take an early 1-0 lead here.
Luiz's pinpoint ball to McGinn was clearly a pre-planned move, giving the skipper the space to take advantage of sluggish Luton defence and pick his spot in the back of the net!
Villa have avoided defeat in their last 17 matches after scoring first in the Premier League, dating back to a 4-2 loss to Arsenal in February.
This season, the hosts have won all five of the games they've taken the lead in.
CLOSE!!! Villa go inches away from a second goal!! Digne latches onto a long pass from Torres, and drills a low ball across the face of goal.
The arriving Watkins refrains from shooting, but keeps the play alive and crosses back into the area.
Zaniolo shoots at the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked behind for a corner by the foot of Kaminski!
Villa win another corner following a mid-air tussle between Kaminski and Torres, but the centre-back's near post header is glanced wide of the target!
Luton win a free-kick and send plenty of numbers into the Aston Villa box, but Doughty's cross from deep is massively overhit and sails behind for a goal-kick.
Cash surges into the final third once again and tees up Zaniolo on the edge of the box, but his snap-shot from 20 yards is easily blocked and dealt with by Osho.
Villa have now scored 10 first-half goals in 10 Premier League games so far, second only to Newcastle's 12 this season.
Ogbene skips around the outside of Kamara and fires a low cross into the six-yard box, but Martinez gets down well to seize possession with Morris ready to pounce!
Kabore bursts onto a loose ball ahead of Zaniolo, but is dragged back cynically by the Italian and Villa's on-loan Roma winger is shown the first yellow card of the game.
Zaniolo twists and turns his way past Nakamba on halfway, but is taken down by the former Villa midfielder and wins a free-kick after there's no advantage to be played.
McGinn rides the challenge of Brown but is then dispossessed by a well-timed sliding tackle from Kabore, and the referee brings play back for the initial free-kick in Aston Villa's favour.

Villa have now scored in 19 consecutive Premier League matches, and given Zaniolo has already managed five shots in the first half-hour here, you wouldn't bet against them adding another before half-time.
Doughty fires a threatening cross into the hosts' box, with Brown arriving late to get on the end of it.
Torres gets there first though, and nods the ball back to Martinez, who will be wanting to spark a Villa attack from deep here.
Cash races forward again to latch onto a cross-field pass from Luiz, but his opponent Doughty stands his ground well and blocks the right-backs attempted cross behind for a corner.
Luton win an attacking free-kick after Kabore is clipped late by Luiz, but Barkley's ball in from the right is sent straight into the gloves of Martinez.
A superb flick from Diaby almost allows Zaniolo to run in behind the defence, but Doughty steps across to knock the ball back to Kaminski.
The danger's far from over though after the Luton goalkeeper stumbles in his attempt to punt the ball, and the sliced clearance falls straight to Cash!
Lockyer's cross-field pass finds Kabore on the run, and the Burkinabe wing-back takes on Digne.
He creates space to cross, but the final ball is atrocious and skews straight out of play!
BLOCKED!! Digne's cut-back into the box is met by Konsa, who keeps the ball alive after having a shot blocked.
He tees up Diaby on the edge, who runs onto it at pace and fires a powerful low finish goalwards, but Nakamba gets in the way for Luton!
We'll play one additional minute at the end of the first half, just as Luiz sizes up a corner for the hosts.
CLOSE!! Luiz's delivery is whipped towards the goal frame at pace, and beats everyone in the box before clipping the upright on its way behind!
HALF-TIME: ASTON VILLA 1-0 LUTON TOWN.

A comfortable first half for Villa comes to an end, though the hosts are only 1-0 up despite creating plenty of opportunities! The Villans were straight onto the front foot, with Zaniolo flashing a volley wide before Kaminski produced a fantastic double save to deny Watkins in the box.

Luton wouldn't hold out for much longer though, giving McGinn far too much time on the edge of the box as the Villa skipper fired home the opener on 17 minutes! Zaniolo and Diaby have since seen chances blocked as Luton entered damage limitation mode, and coming into the break behind by just a solitary goal, a good start to the second-half from the Hatters could really shake things up here!
We're back and ready to go for the next 45 minutes, with Villa keen to press home their advantage.
The second goal of this game, if it comes, could prove crucial - Villa going 2-0 up would all-but guarantee the points, but an equaliser for Luton will blow this game wide open!
Zaniolo was one of Villa's best in the first half, but also picked up a yellow card and is withdrawn at half-time for Leon Bailey.
Diaby kicks off for the hosts, and we're back underway for the second half at Villa Park!
Bailey takes on Doughty as he advances down the right-hand side, but his cross into the area is far too close to Kaminski, who collects for Luton.
Villa have won all four of the games they've led at half-time this season, while in contrast, Luton have lost all four such games so far in 2023-24.
Routine.
GOOOOAAAALL!!!! A dream start to the second half for the hosts! McGinn holds off Mengi to tee up a Digne cross, which is arrowed into the box towards Bailey.
The substitute nods the ball down, and it'll drop for Diaby to rifle a powerful shot into the bottom corner! Villa double their lead, and now 2-0 down, Luton have a mountain to climb here.

text: Bailey did brilliantly to beat Doughty to Digne's cross, and his cushioned header bounced perfectly for Diaby to lash home Villa's second of the game.
Cash slides in on Morris to take both man and ball over the sideline, but the first contact was clearly on the Luton striker and Cash can have no complaints when he's shown a yellow card.
Successive crosses from Kabore are headed away by Villa, and McGinn sets off on the counter-attack from the second clearance.
Kabore chases him down, but then takes the Villa skipper to ground and is shown a yellow card by the referee.
Ogbene and Doughty play a quick one-two down the left wing and the latter arcs a cross into the box.
There's very few Luton shirts to aim at though, and Martinez rushes off his line to take the catch.
CHANCE!!! Watkins spreads the play wide to Bailey, who crosses back towards his striker in the area.
Lockyer races across in cover, and does just enough to block Watkins' shot behind for a corner!
Luton make their first changes of the match, the first of which sees Osho withdrawn for the far more attack-minded threat of Andros Townsend.
Brown also heads off having been rather anonymous in the final third, and Tahith Chong will slot into the vacated attacking position for Luton.

Digne bursts forward to get on the end of Torres' clipped pass in behind the defence, but Kabore gets back in cover to block the left-back's cross, and still manages to keep the ball in the field of play!
Chong's throughball down the left opens up space for Doughty to run into, but Cash tracks him all the way and deflects his attempted cross behind for a rare Luton corner.
The initial corner comes to nothing for Luton, but Doughty taps the ball back for Barkley on the edge of the box.
He gets a good run-up to strike a first-time effort goalwards, but the 25-yard shot is always rising as it sails over the top of the bar!
OWN GOAL!!! Things go from bad to worse for Luton! Kamara's lofted pass over the top causes all sorts of problems at the back for the Hatters as Diaby steams onto it.

He cuts the ball back across the face of goal, which ricochets off Lockyer and rolls into the back of the net! A third goal for the hosts courtesy of the unfortunate Luton captain, and at 3-0 up, Villa are closing in on three points here.
As things stand, Villa have climbed a place into the Premier League top four, while Luton are set to miss out on the chance to climb out of the bottom three!
Ogbene takes on Digne down the right in a bid to create crossing space for the Hatters, but a loose touch allows the Villans' left-back to win possession and clear the ball down-field.
Barkley is clipped and dispossessed in his own defensive third by Diaby, and the referee calls play back for the free-kick just as Watkins looks set to run through on goal!

Townsend's back-heel gives Ogbene the space to beat Digne and put in a cross from the byline, but there's not enough Luton shirts in the box and his floated ball to the back post is easily dealt with.
Luton break at speed down the right-hand side as Morris plays Ogbene into open space, but Kamara surges back in cover and takes the Ireland winger out with a poorly-timed sliding challenge.
It's as textbook a yellow card as you'll see, and gives the Hatters a free-kick right on the edge of the box.
CHANCE!!! What a challenge! The Hatters' free-kick is played short to Doughty by Townsend, but it's easily cut out by Luiz and Villa flood forward on the counter-attack.
The Brazilian canters over halfway before playing in Bailey to his left, but Kabore slides in brilliantly to prevent the shot and win the ball back for Luton!
Bailey taps the ball past Doughty, looking to run in behind, but he's prevented from doing so by the Luton left-back, whose shirt-grabbing challenge earns him a yellow card.
Two more changes coming for Luton, the first of which sees Zimbabwe midfielder Nakamba replaced by Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu in the middle of the park.
Another alteration up front for Luton also sees Elijah Adebayo introduced, taking Morris' place in the number nine role for the visitors.
WIDE!!! That really should've been number four! Bailey and Diaby combine as the France forward turns and races through the middle.
He plays in Bailey to his right, but the Jamaican's shot flashes across the face of goal and wide of the far post!

text: The booked Doughty comes off in Luton's final change, and Ryan Giles will see out the game in the left-back position for the Hatters.
Kamara comes off for Villa having also picked up a yellow card, and Youri Tielemans replaces him in the middle of the park.
Diego Carlos will also come on to see out proceedings for the hosts, replacing Cash in a change that'll likely see him slot in at right-back.
CHANCE!! Bailey latches onto another incisive ball over the top for Villa, and cuts it back into the middle.
McGinn arrives with the goal at his mercy, but scuffs his first-time shot and sends it rolling into the gloves of Kaminski!
OWN GOAL!!! Another bizarre goal goes in, gifting Luton a lifeline in comical fashion! Townsend's cross from the right is met by Konsa, who nods the ball up and then back to Martinez.

However, the header loops over the goalkeeper's head and onto the crossbar, hitting the sprawling Martinez in the back and landing in the back of the net! 3-1 inside the final 10 minutes at Villa Park, and could that be the stroke of luck Luton needed to mount a late comeback here?

Ogbene's goal against Forest last time out also came in the 83rd minute, and ended up being the first of a late surge that saw Luton equalise in injury time! They're further behind by two in this one, but stranger things have happened in football - could the ultimate comeback be on?

WIDE!!! Tielemans' foul on Chong gives Luton an attacking free-kick, but Townsend's pinpoint cross into the box is headed wide by Mendi, despite the defender having no-one near him and plenty of time to send the effort on target!
Luton have been a fan on late goals this season, scoring six in the last 15 minutes of their 10 games so far.
Only Arsenal (eight) and Liverpool (seven) have scored more in the 2023-24 Premier League.
Villa make two more changes late in the game, with Luiz replaced at the base of their midfield by Leander Dendoncker.
Diaby also comes off having scored Villa's second early in this half, and Bertrand Traore will take his place up front for the final throws here.
We're into four additional minutes at Villa Park - does that give Luton enough time to claw another goal or two back?
BLOCKED!!! Almost another gift for Luton! A dawdling Dendoncker loses out to Barkley on the edge of his own box, and the ball drops to Adebayo.
He looks to fire home from close range, but Torres steps across from nowhere to make a crucial block and send the effort behind for a corner!
CHANCE!!! Successive corners give Luton another late chance at a second, and the ball's bouncing all over the place before being turned goalwards by Barkley.
He's off-balance as he shoots though, and can only send a tame effort into the grateful gloves of Martinez.
FULL-TIME: ASTON VILLA 3-1 LUTON TOWN.
It's all over at Villa Park, as the hosts make their dominance count to seal a comfortable three points.
Spurning several chances in the game's first 45 minutes, Villa wasted no time in the second as Diaby doubled their lead with a low drive from close range.

Already 2-0 up with the second period just four minutes old, Unai Emery's side looked to push the envelope and again went close through Watkins, before Luton captain Lockyer accidentally turned the ball into his own net for 3-0.
That didn't stem the flow of chances though, with Kabore making a crucial challenge to deny Bailey before both the Jamaican and captain McGinn blazed wide from close range.

Another own goal would give Luton some parity late in the game, following some slapstick defending from Konsa and Martinez, but despite Mendi and Adebayo having opportunities to close the gap further, the Hatters were thoroughly second-best throughout and lost 3-1 to a Villa side who are proving to be this season's surprise package.
Other results keep the Villans in fifth, just a point outside the Champions League places, while Luton remain languishing in 18th following their seventh defeat of the season.
